correctness.rationale: The uncovered-vertex product criterion exhausts support cases. An edge cannot be redundant unless both endpoints retain covered status after deletion in the single omitted-pair case, which proves the star-forest equivalence. Component count bounds the maximum, and diagonal nonedges force equal opposite-star centers. Minimum size is a perfect matching on all but one deleted matched pair, giving derangements. Direct exhaustive tests examine 1,052,736 subsets and independently test equality at n=5.
